name: Queen's University at Kingston
summary: Royal Charter of 1841; a campus in Kingston, Ontario, with a first-year residence guarantee and Arts, Commerce, Engineering and Computing degrees.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma: six subjects, three at HL, no mark below 3, total at least 28 excluding bonus points, plus program prerequisites. Maths AI SL is not accepted where Maths is a prerequisite.

dates.label: Recommended OUAC application date if you want a Major Admission Award
Application deadline, all programs except Commerce, Health Sciences and Nursing
All documents due, including transcripts and English test scores

programmes.name: Commerce
programmes.about: A four-year honours business degree at the Smith School of Business with eleven fields of study, from accounting and finance to digital technology, plus exchange options in 120+ locations and structured career support.
programmes.ib: Maths and English at 5 or better (predicted or final); Maths AI SL not accepted. A mandatory Supplementary Application is part of the file.
programmes.selectionNote: Required courses and marks, plus a mandatory Supplementary Application read for academic aptitude, self-awareness, leadership and teamwork. 28 is the floor, not the typical score.

flagshipSource.title: Smith Commerce: eleven fields of study, 120+ exchange locations and a four-year honours degree

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: Start in a shared General First Year with a guaranteed choice among 10 disciplines, or apply Direct Entry to a program such as Civil, Electrical or Mechatronics and Robotics. Optional 12 to 16 month paid internships.
programmes.ib: Maths, Chemistry, Physics and English; the admission average uses only these four prerequisite subjects. Maths AI SL is not accepted.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your marks in the four prerequisite subjects; international applicants with a 90% average or higher get automatic scholarships and awards. 28 is the floor.

flagshipSource.title: Smith Engineering: General First Year or Direct Entry, 96% of graduates employed within two years

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts and Science
faculties.line: Arts and Economics need English only; Computing needs English and Maths (not AI SL); Science programs add lab sciences.

faculties.name: Smith School of Business (Commerce)
faculties.line: Maths and English at 5+, plus a mandatory Supplementary Application read alongside your grades.

faculties.name: Smith Engineering
faculties.line: Maths, Chemistry, Physics and English; the admission average counts only these four; General First Year or Direct Entry.

faculties.name: Health Sciences and Nursing
faculties.line: Earlier deadline than most programs and a mandatory Supplementary Application, as for Commerce.

faculties.name: Concurrent Education
faculties.line: Combined education degrees need English, plus Maths and sciences for the Science stream; Music adds an audition and theory test.

notes: Queen's offers a first-year residence guarantee and early move-in for international students.
International applicants with a 90% average or higher receive automatic scholarships and awards; Major Admission Awards need a separate online application.
The IB score is read excluding bonus points, and the engineering average uses only the prerequisite subjects.
